action.objective: Deliver Qc8+ with check, forcing Black's king to move and winning material on b7 while keeping our queen active and safe.
action.rationale: Qc8+ (f5c8) is the only move with exact, commit_ready verification at depth 4: score +47 (Qc8+ e8f7 Rb1xb7+ Kg8), plus its safety probe found no immediate mate and noted no black captures after the check (queen lands on c8 defended by nothing needed since it is a check). By contrast g2g3 scored -470 at depth 2 (upper-bound style), far worse and king-exposing to a3a2 and Qxe3+ tactics. The queen check wins the b7 pawn and drives the king, so I commit f5c8.
